whatThisPluginAdds.text: Address adds site-scoped country and postal-address records, admin resources, and shared address selectors for other Capell packages.

surfaceOutcome.text: Admins manage countries and reusable addresses, then select saved address data while editing a site.

developers.text: The package contributes AddressResource, CountryResource, reusable form fields, and a site schema extender instead of making each package model location fields again.

teams.text: A postal address can be corrected once and reused wherever a Capell workflow references it.
